title: Possession proof over the first challenge
description: The proof is NOT a signature over the challenge. It signs a domain-separated message built from values both sides hold — Anis stores only the challenge's hash — joined by \n with none after the last line: the separator, the keyId in lower-case D form, the generation, the lower-case hex SHA-256 of the challenge's UTF-8 bytes, and the thumbprint Anis returned. P1363, 64 bytes, base64url without padding.

expected.signatureEncoding: IEEE P1363 r||s, 64 bytes, base64url without padding (86 characters)
